label: Figure 27.1: The balancing balance of payments
alt: Balance-scale diagram showing the current account balanced on one side against the sum of the capital account, financial account and net errors and omissions on the other.
caption: Shown as a balancing equation rather than an x–y graph: Current account = Capital account + Financial account + Net errors and omissions. Whatever its sign, the current account balance is always exactly offset by the combined capital and financial account balance, with any measurement gaps absorbed by net errors and omissions, so the overall balance of payments sums to zero by construction.
